records.title: JM ECOSTATE — Build Mesh v1.0.6 — Estate Keeper Convergence
records.status: CURRENT DECLARED · PACKAGE v1.0.6 · HOSTED MCP v0.7.5 KEEPER-CONTRACT DESCENDANT
records.summary: JM ECOSTATE Build Mesh is the recoverable Estate control plane for exact current-head authority, proof boundaries, capability/donor meshing, deterministic operation planning, artifact-general routing and delta-first host-side Estate maintenance without private-Library ingestion.
records.proof: Private plugin v1.0.6 was updated in-place and read back under the existing plugin identity with the Estate Keeper skill and preserved app/MCP binding. Hosted MCP v0.7.5 inherits v0.7.4 discovery≠authority separation and adds a 17th read-only estate_keeper_contract tool. Runtime deployment/readback remains the separate Ding gate and is not pre-claimed by this registry record.
records.boundary: Public Build Mesh remains read-only and does not own or ingest the private Estate/Library. Fuzzy discovery is not authority. The Keeper returns a host/private maintenance contract only; private contact and authorized Library consequence remain host-side, with readback required before Ding.

records.title: JM LLM Core v1.1 — Symbiosis Cycle 001
records.status: FLAZ COMPLETE · SYMBIOSIS CYCLE 001 · FIRST CAPABILITY-RETURN DING
records.summary: Forward descendant over the frozen v1.0 First Complete Edition. Cycle 001 used the ECOSTATE/JM Learn residual-gap route to acquire bounded modular-arithmetic capability through a separately measured learned-weight research child plus a learned modular router and auditable executor, while preserving the v1.0 parent and regression lanes.
records.proof: Untouched modular-arithmetic system test 200/200 PASS; original v1.0 smoke 7/7 PASS; fixed modular baseline 0/8 → 8/8. Learned-weight child reduced held-out modular response NLL by 69.46%, ECOSTATE-law NLL by 73.10% and old-instruction NLL by 11.57%, but free modular generation remained 0/8 and is not crowned.
records.boundary: Bounded modular arithmetic is earned at learned-route + auditable-executor system scope. v1.0 remains the protected frozen parent. Not general mathematics, mathematical induction, broad formal logic, transformer-weight modular reasoning, unrestricted free generation, AGI or human-level intelligence.
